articles.summary: Procore has named COMPASS by Bespoke Metrics its preferred subcontractor prequalification solution, launching Prequal for All for all Procore users. COMPASS centralizes financial, safety, insurance, and operational data into a Q Score with prequalification outcomes embedded directly in Procore workflows.
